intro: How the imperfect subjunctive is formed in every verb, and the five places where you need it.
p.hablara.consejo: It comes from «hablaron»: no «-ron», plus «-ra». It is regular and the initial h is silent.
p.comiera.consejo: Verbs in -er and -ir take «-iera»: «comieron» gives «comiera» and «vivieron» gives «viviera».
p.fuera.consejo: It does not change with yo, él and ella. With «nosotros» it takes an accent: «fuéramos».
p.tuviera.consejo: It is irregular because «tuvieron» is: the stem «tuv-» passes to every person.
p.pudiera.consejo: It comes from «pudieron»: the stem is «pud-». It sounds pu-DYE-ra.
p.hiciera.consejo: It is written with c because «hicieron» has c. The c sounds like th: i-THYE-ra.
p.dijera.consejo: «Dijeron» loses the i before the ending: you say «dijera», never «dijiera».
p.supiera.consejo: It comes from «supieron»: «saber» uses the stem «sup-» in this tense.
p.viniera.consejo: From «vinieron». It is used after a past verb: «no creía que viniera».
p.hablase.consejo: It is the form with «-se»: it means the same as «hablara». It is seen more in written texts.
p.quisiera.consejo: With «quisiera» you ask politely: «quisiera un café». It sounds softer than «quiero».
p.boda.consejo: It is feminine: «la boda», «mi boda». It is written with b, though it sounds like v.
p.confiar en.consejo: It goes with «en»: «confío en ti». The «ia» in «confiar» sounds like one beat: kon-FYAR.
p.vestido.consejo: It is masculine: «el vestido». It comes from «vestir», and the v sounds like b.
b1.texto:
There is one recipe for every verb:

1. Take the **ellos** form of the preterite: hablaron, comieron, tuvieron.
2. Drop **-ron**: habla-, comie-, tuvie-.
3. Add **-ra, -ras, -ra, -ramos, -rais, -ran**: **hablara**, **comiera**, **tuviera**.

Irregular verbs already bring their stem: fueron → **fuera**, dijeron → **dijera**, hicieron → **hiciera**.

There is a second series with **-se**: hablase, comiese, fuese. It means the same.
b2.f0.texto: I would like to ask you a favour.
b2.f2.texto: I would like you to come to my wedding in June.
b2.f3.texto: I did not think it was so soon.
b2.f4.texto: My parents wanted us to wait one more year.
b2.f5.texto: And what did you tell them?
b2.f6.texto: I asked them to trust me.
b2.f7.texto: You talk as if you were already married.
b2.f8.texto: I wish I already had the dress.
b4.titulo: Five places for the imperfect subjunctive
b4.texto:
You need it in five cases:

1. After a verb in the **past** or in the **conditional**: Quería que **vinieras**. Me gustaría que **vinieras**. No creía que **fuera** verdad.
2. After **si**, when something is imagined: Si **tuviera** tiempo…
3. After **ojalá**, for an unlikely wish: Ojalá **hiciera** sol.
4. After **como si**: Habla como si lo **supiera**.
5. In **quisiera**, to ask politely: Quisiera un café.

The **nosotros** person takes an accent: habl**á**ramos, com**ié**ramos, f**ué**ramos.
b4.e0.texto: I did not believe it was true.
b4.e1.texto: I wish the sun were out.
b4.e2.texto: I would like a white coffee, please.
b5.f0.texto: In the upstairs room, the white dress hangs from a wooden hanger.
b5.f1.texto: Lucía touches it with her fingertips, as if it were made of glass.
b5.f2.texto: Through the open window comes the warm evening air.
b5.f3.texto: Downstairs sound the laughter of her cousins and the noise of the chairs.
b5.f4.texto: Time seems slower inside that house.
b5.f5.texto: Her mother wanted the dress to be long and simple.
b5.f6.texto: She preferred one that was shorter and lighter.
b5.f7.texto: In the end, the dressmaker proposed a very soft blue fabric.
b5.f8.texto: Mother and daughter looked at each other in the mirror without saying anything.
b5.f9.texto: Afterwards, both smiled as if summer were already there.
b6.o1.refuerzo: That form does not exist: the stem «comie-» keeps the i.
b6.o2.refuerzo: «Comería» is the conditional, a different tense.
b6.pregunta: Drop «-ron» from «comieron» and add «-ra». What results?
b7.o0.refuerzo: «Sea» is present subjunctive; «creía» is in the past.
b7.o1.refuerzo: «Era» is indicative, and «no creía que» asks for the subjunctive.
b7.pregunta: It is something you thought yesterday. Which form is missing?
b8.frase: Me gustaría que vinieras a mi boda
b8.traduccion: I would like you to come to my wedding
b9.o0.refuerzo: «Dijeron» already lost the i: it does not come back.
b9.o1.refuerzo: Well done! Without «-ron» you get «dije-» and add «-ra».
b9.o2.refuerzo: That form does not exist: the preterite stem is «dij-».
b9.pregunta: Start from «dijeron». Which form is correct?
b10.o0.refuerzo: «Estás» is indicative and «como si» does not accept it here.
b10.o1.refuerzo: Correct: «como si» asks for the imperfect subjunctive.
b10.o2.refuerzo: «Estarías» is conditional and does not follow «como si».
b10.pregunta: It is an unreal comparison. Which form is missing?
b11.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «I would like you to come.»
b12.o0.refuerzo: It is a direct order: not very polite in a café.
b12.o1.refuerzo: It is correct, but more direct than «quisiera».
p.pedirte.consejo: The infinitive «pedir» with «te» joined at the end. «Te» is the person you ask.
p.claro.consejo: Also an adjective meaning clear or light. As an answer it means «of course».
p.dime.consejo: Command of «decir» for tú with «me» attached: «di» + «me». The accent stays on «di».
p.junio.consejo: In Spanish, months are written with a small letter: «junio». The j sounds like h.
p.pensaba.consejo: Imperfect of «pensar». With a negative, «no pensaba que» asks for the subjunctive.
p.esperáramos.consejo: From «esperaron». With nosotros it takes an accent: «esperáramos».
p.dijiste.consejo: Preterite of «decir» for tú. The j sounds like h: di-HIS-te.
p.pedí.consejo: Preterite of «pedir» for yo. The accent on the final «í» shows the stress.
p.confiaran.consejo: From «confiaron»: «-ron» becomes «-ran». It goes with «en»: «confiar en mí».
p.estuvieras.consejo: From «estuvieron»: the irregular stem «estuv-» gives «estuvieras». Used after «como si».
p.creía.consejo: Imperfect of «creer». The accent on «í» separates the vowels: kre-Í-a. «No creía que» asks for the subjunctive.
p.verdad.consejo: It is feminine: «la verdad». It ends in -dad, so the stress is on the end: ber-DAD.
p.percha.consejo: It is feminine: «una percha». The ch sounds as in «chocolate»: PER-cha.
p.tibio.consejo: Masculine of «tibia». It agrees with «aire». The «io» sounds as one beat: TI-byo.
p.abajo.consejo: The opposite of «arriba». The j sounds like h: a-BA-ho. It never changes.
p.primas.consejo: Plural of «prima». The masculine is «primo». Together: «primos», cousins of any gender.
p.sillas.consejo: Plural of «silla». The ll sounds like y: SI-yas. It is feminine.
p.sencillo.consejo: Masculine of «sencilla». The c sounds like th and the ll like y: sen-THI-yo.
p.prefería.consejo: Imperfect of «preferir». In the present the e changes: «prefiero»; here it does not.
p.ligero.consejo: Masculine of «ligera». The j sounds like h: li-HE-ro. The opposite is «pesado».
p.modista.consejo: Ends in -ista, so it is the same for men and women: «el modista», «la modista».
p.propuso.consejo: Irregular preterite of «proponer», like «puso». There is no accent: pro-PU-so.
p.hija.consejo: The h is silent and the j sounds like h: I-ha. The masculine is «hijo».
p.miraron.consejo: Preterite of «mirar» for ellos. With «se» it means each other: «se miraron».
p.ambas.consejo: Feminine of «ambos». It means both, and is a bit literary. Its stress falls on the first syllable.
p.sonrieron.consejo: Preterite of «sonreír» for ellos. The i of «-ieron» is lost: «sonrieron», not «sonrieieron».
p.estuviera.consejo: From «estuvieron»: the irregular stem «estuv-» gives «estuviera». Used after «como si».
